from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "The Foundation: Understanding Independence"
        lines = [
            "Events are independent if they don't affect each other.",
            "A coin flip doesn't change a die roll result.",
            "One outcome gives no information about the other.",
            "Their joint probability is the product of individual probabilities.",
            "Visually, the intersection area matches this product."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        COIN_COLOR = "#ADD8E6"
        DIE_COLOR = "#FFB6C1"
        FORMULA_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display a coin (Circle labeled A) and a die (Square labeled B) on opposite sides
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COIN_COLOR)
        
        coin_circle = Circle(radius=0.5, color=COIN_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        coin_label = Text("A", font_size=24, color=COIN_COLOR)
        coin_group = VGroup(coin_circle, coin_label)
        self.place_at_grid(coin_group, "B2")
        
        die_square = Square(side_length=1.0, color=DIE_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        die_label = Text("B", font_size=24, color=DIE_COLOR)
        die_group = VGroup(die_square, die_label)
        self.place_at_grid(die_group, "B5")
        
        self.play(Create(coin_group), Create(die_group))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Flash the coin (A) and then the die (B)
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(DIE_COLOR)
        
        self.play(Flash(coin_group, color=COIN_COLOR, line_length=0.3))
        self.play(Flash(die_group, color=DIE_COLOR, line_length=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "One outcome gives no information about the other."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Move A and B to center, show formula "P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)" below them
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(FORMULA_COLOR)
        
        self.play(
            coin_group.animate.move_to(self.grid["C3"]),
            die_group.animate.move_to(self.grid["C4"]),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        formula = MathTex(r"P(A \cap B) = P(A) \times P(B)", color=FORMULA_COLOR, font_size=36)
        self.place_in_area(formula, "E2", "E5")
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Visually, the intersection area matches this product.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(GREEN_A)
        
        # Highlight the overlap
        intersection_highlight = Intersection(coin_circle, die_square, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.5)
        # Match current positions - intersection needs to be calculated on the actual mobjects after movement
        intersection_highlight.move_to((coin_group.get_center() + die_group.get_center()) / 2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(intersection_highlight))
        self.play(Indicate(intersection_highlight))
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Cleanup colors for final state
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(1)
